The slowdown came despite a soft comparison with last October, which points to cooling momentum rather than base effects.Retail sales were weaker still, rising just 0.4% against expectations of 0.8%, which matches August’s subdued pace. Household spending remains fragile, weighed down by falling home prices and cautious consumers. items.title: Milk and wine used in Menorcan funerary rituals over 2,000 years ago
items.summary: In the Late Iron Age, or post-Talayotic period, over 2,000 years ago, Menorca and the other Balearic Islands experienced increasing connectivity with the wider Mediterranean. However, they also maintained distinctive local funerary traditions, such as burying their loved ones in rock-cut tombs, or artificial caves. Some of these caves contained external courtyards located in front of the burial chambers where animal offerings might have been made. Archaeologists even suspect that perishable foods or liquids were offered in characteristic island containers, such as high-bottomed vessels. Until now, however, the contents of these ceramic containers had never been identified.

Multiple boys sports saw participation decreases in two time periods within the past three calendar years. Football took a big hit with a 9% drop in participation from 2024-2025 to 2025-2026. There were 8,831 boys playing football in 2024-2025, but 8,015 in 2025-2026. Overall, Connecticut saw over 4% fewer participants in 2025-2026 than it did in 2024-2025, according to CIAC numbers. There were 58,605 boys who played sports in 2024-2025, but that decreased to 55,990 in 2025-2026. Six-percent decreases were seen in swimming and indoor track. Swimming declined from 1,606 boys in 2024-2025 to 1,513 in 2025-2026. Indoor track fell from 5,703 boys in 2024-2025 to 5,387 in 2025-2026.

The NFL's new player safety policy brings one-game suspensions for repeat violations, but no Buccaneers appear on the latest watch list. The NFL and NFL Players Association announced the changes on August 26, establishing a disciplinary system targeting five specific violations: hip-drop tackles, horse-collar tackles, launching, hits on defenseless players, and blindside blocks. Players who commit three violations of the same designated rule face a one-game suspension, making repeated dangerous techniques a potential personnel concern rather than simply a financial penalty.

Is your gaming PC underperforming? You might have your monitor plugged into the wrong port. Here Your monitor might be connected to the motherboard instead of your graphics card, and the fix takes only a cable swap. LIAL/Shutterstock Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover You may have a great graphics card in your gaming desktop and still be disappointed with its performance because of where the monitor is plugged in. Many PCs have HDMI, DisplayPort and USB-C monitor connections in two places: on the motherboard and on the dedicated graphics card. The same cable can fit either set of ports, which isn't particularly helpful.

Slowly, gently, haltingly, the Starship upper stage eased its way toward the waiting tower where two arms extended outward, awaiting expectantly. The margins are so incredibly narrow. Two nubs on either side of the rocket, each protruding only about one foot, were the only purchase the rocket would have on the arms. Then, less than a minute after it came into view, the Starship upper stage was snagged by the launch tower, as snug as you like. And so it was all over. SpaceX, nearly a quarter of a century after its founding, had just taken a hugely significant step toward developing and optimizing a massive, rapidly reusable rocket.

Despite handling the most flights in the world, the United States’ air traffic systems rely on 1980s-era computer equipment. It took Canada two years to replace paper flight strips with electronic ones in air traffic control towers, a simple transition to avoid cascading delays. In the United States, the same project has taken more than four decades, and it is still not complete. The example highlights an irony. Despite handling the most flights in the world, America’s air traffic control systems — still using 1980s-era equipment and prone to widespread failures — have lagged behind some global peers when it comes to improving technology.

The social media giant is accused of not informing 20 million users it had access to their photos. Italian regulators have fined social media giant Meta €805m (£670m; $887m) for accessing Android users' photos without their specific consent. The fine is among the largest an Italian authority has ever imposed on a tech giant.

Stop mindlessly hitting putts. A simple deck of cards creates real pressure and exposes weak spots in your short game according to Golf.com. Chris George, a teacher featured by Golf.com , outlines a drill that uses a standard deck to dictate every shot. The setup is easy. Split the cards into two piles: face cards plus aces, and the numbered cards. Shuffle both. The card drawn sets the distance, the direction, and the slope. Numbered cards show the feet for the putt. Face cards have fixed lengths: Jacks are 15 feet, Queens are 20, Kings are 25, and Aces stretch to 35 feet.

NASA's Voyager 1 is about to become humanity's first object to reach one light-day from Earth as it pushes ever deeper into interstellar space. That's a mind-blowing distance of more than 16 billion miles (26 billion kilometers) for the spacecraft launched 49 years ago. When Voyager 1 reaches that remarkable milestone on Wednesday, its radio signals will take precisely 24 hours traveling at the speed of light to reach Earth—in other words, one light-day. NASA is looking at another 18,000 years before the spacecraft achieves a full light-year and more than double that before it comes near another star.

You feel overlooked, but your parents’ disappointing behaviour does not necessarily mean they don’t love you I turned 40 a few years ago . For my 21st and 30th birthdays I got jewellery from my parents, so when they didn’t ask what I wanted, I assumed they would follow this tradition. But I got nothing. Not even an apology. It later transpired that they thought I was turning 41. But even then to receive nothing is hurtful . They blamed it on old age and said they had been struggling with their health. Then, out of nowhere, his heart started pounding and his chest ached. When he tried to stand, "the world narrowed," Perez said. Perez called his daughter-in-law, a doctor, and she recommended he go to the emergency room. His wife brought him to the hospital. There, doctors determined that he was experiencing atrial fibrillation, or AFib , when the heart beats irregularly. The common condition can be dangerous: If left untreated, it can lead to stroke or heart failure.

COVID-19 lockdowns cut global fire activity by 12.3 percent. Many things can cause wildfires, but humans are the only factor that can also make preventative efforts. The difference between PC GPUs and video game console GPUs is that consoles use a single, combined CPU and GPU unit whereas PCs keep them separate. Both have the same underlying tech, but console versions share more with the CPU. Luke James for Engadget Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Take the side panel off a gaming PC and the graphics card is the first thing you'll see. It's a slab the size of a hardback book slotted into the motherboard with fans bolted to it. But open up a PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X and you'll see nothing of the kind. Instead, beneath the heatsink sits an AMD chip doing the work of both processor and graphics card.

Lindy Duncan won for the first time in 222 starts on the LPGA Tour on Sunday at the Annika, pulling away from Hye Jin Choi on the back nine. Duncan tapped in a 4-foot par putt on the final hole, and there was a long line of LPGA players waited to douse water on a player who has endeared herself over the years for her remarkable perseverance amid a battle of self-doubts. Duncan, 35, is the oldest first-time winner on the LPGA since Leta Lindley was 36 when she won the Corning Classic in 2008. "I have so many people to thank that believed in me when I wasn't sure I wanted to keep playing of if I was good enough to keep playing," Duncan said. "To be here, I'm completely shocked."

Protesters say the move will stifle media freedom, while the government insists broadcasters need to cut costs. Thousands of people have gathered in central Prague to protest against the Czech government's plans to scrap the licence fee and use the state budget to fund public media. The coalition government - which consists of the populist ANO party and two right-wing Eurosceptic parties - insists the change will not affect editorial independence, but wants broadcasters to cut costs. Parliament passed the first draft of the proposal late last month. Since then, thousands of Czechs have taken part in protests.

The wingtip of a Copa Airlines Boeing 737 struck the nose of a UPS Boeing 767, a day after a nationwide ground stop disrupted air travel. The "sponge on a string" tests can be done in GP surgeries, rather than hospitals, unlike endoscopy checks that use a small camera. Some people with bad and persistent indigestion should be offered quick "sponge in the gullet" tests to check for oesophageal cancer, new draft guidelines for the NHS in England recommend. The sponge tests can be carried out in GP surgeries in minutes, and are less invasive than hospital endoscopy checks that instead use a small camera to look inside the body. They tests are already available in some places but could now be offered across England.

When Tatis came to the Padres, he was a solid prospect that San Diego managed to flip veteran pitcher James Shields for. That trade with the Chicago White Sox quickly became one of the most lopsided in MLB history. Tatis became a star in San Diego, slugging 42 homers in 2021. Meanwhile, Shields made just 76 starts for Chicago before retiring. Tatis' 2026 season started off rather unfortunately. The right fielder started the season going 55 games (207 at-bats) without a home run. It was the longest drought of his career. It's the second-longest drought to start a season by any player in history who had previously hit 40-plus homers. Tatis' power seemed to go dormant, until it didn't.

Left-hander Tim Hill is staying with the New York Yankees, agreeing to a $2.25 million, one-year contract, a person familiar with the negotiations told The Associated Press on Sunday. The person spoke on condition of anonymity because the agreement had not yet been announced. Hill's deal was first reported by ESPN. A 36-year-old reliever, Hill was 5-2 with a 4.60 ERA and two saves in 58 2/3 innings over 67 appearances last season. He allowed a career-high 12 homers, three more than his previous high. Hill's 68.8% ground-ball percentage led the major leagues among pitchers with 50 or more innings. He held left-handed batters to a .213 batting average while righties hit .293 against him.

(AP) — It is common for UConn to see games decided by 18 or more points. It's rare when the Huskies have been on the losing end of those contests. Seventh-ranked Louisville handed the No. 4 Huskies a rare 69-51 rout on Sunday night. UConn shot a season-low 34% (21 of 61) while scoring its fewest points since falling 62-48 to South Carolina in the Final Four last spring. Serbia’s student movement was deliberately leaderless and made group decisions to unseat Aleksandar Vucic. Now no one seems quite sure what happens next. They had no leader, no political party and no conventional campaign. They made decisions by raising their hands after hours of debate in university classrooms, a slow and cumbersome process billed as a unique experiment in direct democracy. That free-form approach to politics of Serbia’s students proved so effective that, in a general election on Oct. 25, they achieved what established opposition parties had failed to accomplish for more than a decade: routing the well-oiled political machine of Serbia’s strongman leader, Aleksandar Vucic.

Cam Ward continued to show signs of improvement in Week 10, passing for 231 yards and running for 39 more against Jacksonville. Why It Matters: Fantasy managers are trying to determine if Ward can be a viable asset, although he is starting to redeem himself after a rough start to the season. Ward, who threw for a career-high 304 yards in Week 8 against Cincinnati, is a low-end QB2 option at best most of the time, but he has a favorable matchup in Week 11 against a porous Dallas Cowboys pass defense.

A House of Lords committee says more preparation is needed for war, power cuts, and cyber-attacks. Workers should be able to take paid time off to prepare for national emergencies, a House of Lords committee has recommended. In a report, the peers said a new "civic resilience leave" would enable employees to undertake training and emergency volunteering without losing income. It is one of a slew of recommendations from a 12-strong committee that has been examining how to make the UK better able to respond to crises including war, power cuts, cyber-attacks and natural disasters.

Ministers last month announced the Jackdaw gas field, which lies 150 miles east of Aberdeen, had been approved after years of uncertainty. Gas has begun flowing from the Jackdaw gas field, with the UK energy secretary saying it will help to heat millions of homes and businesses this winter. The UK government approved production from the gas field in the North Sea last month, amid intense debate about the project's environmental and economic impact.

Pat Freiermuth scored a late 27-yard touchdown as part of a 2-35-1 line against the Bengals in Week 10.
